sanskrit_verse:
आततायिद्विजाज्ञानां धर्मयुद्धेन हिंसनम् ।
इमान् धर्मान् कलियुगे वर्ज्यानाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥४॥
transliteration: ātatāyidvijāgyāṇāṃ dharmayuddhena hiṃsanam / imān dharmān kaliyuge varjyān āhur manīṣiṇaḥ // BrhS_1,23.4
sph_interpretive_translation: In Kali Yuga, violence against those who know the Vedas and commit aggression is sanctioned through dharmic warfare; however, certain dharmic principles are declared forbidden by discerning sages.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from Vedic knowledge and spiritual integrity
Causation arises from violation of sacred order (Ṛta)
Capacity-based responsibility depends on Vedic awareness and conscious transgression
Restoration logic requires realignment with dharma through purification of intent
Consciousness alignment demands cessation of distortion through reintegration protocols
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent knowingly violates Ṛta THEN initiate dharmic warfare protocol
IF agent possesses Vedic cognition AND commits aggression THEN authorize defensive countermeasure
IF epoch is Kali Yuga AND action aligns with dharmic defense THEN permit intervention without punitive consequence
IF sage declares prohibition on specific dharmic act THEN enforce non-engagement in said act within jurisdiction
IF consciousness misalignment detected THEN deploy restoration matrix via śuddhi tantra
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority shall recognize that in Kali Yuga, protection of Vedic cognizant beings takes precedence over general pacifism. However, acts specifically proscribed by enlightened jurisprudence must be excluded even in defensive contexts. The threshold for invoking dharmic warfare lies exclusively in verified Vedic cognition under threat.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal sequence: first comes Vedic knowing, then aggression, then dharmic response. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures proportional response—limited to restoration of sacred balance. No punitive intent is entertained; only completion of karmic disruption through corrective alignment. Reality remains non-punitive as consciousness itself adjudicates truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Śuddhi Tantra to purify aggressor's field of intention
Deploy Dharmic Witness Council to restore violated Ṛta
Engage Vakya Siddhi process to dissolve false declarations made during aggression
Activate Samadhi Alignment Protocol for victim to reintegrate displaced energy
Execute Karma Completion Sequence ensuring no residual distortion remains
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma stands restored. Reality reflects non-punitivity. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
